adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` can return `nil` when the record doesn’t exist, and `save_host(host)` immediately dereferences it (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`), which would raise `NoMethodError` and produce a 500 rather than a 404/not-found response. The diff shows no guard or `find`/rescue handling. (Same nil-risk exists in `destroy` with `host.destroy`.)
